params.body:
## What

The planning steps of a transport after payment (transport requested, pick-up confirmed, completed) are the platform's work. Until now R S4-10.11 let the requesting garage set the next step on its own transport: through `POST transport/next/{uuid}`, through the bulk route `POST transport/states`, and through a button in the transport window. #902 removed the controls from the garage's overview only; the routes and the window still offered the step.

## Paths closed

A search for every writer of the three planning states (`Transport::PLANNING_STATES`, `TransportService::nextPlanningState`, the literal state names, mass updates on the model and the table) finds two, both in `TransportController`. There is no API route, Livewire component, job or command that sets them.

- `TransportController::nextStep` (`transport.update.next`): a platform administrator only. A garage user gets 403 and the state does not move, on its own transport and on anyone else's.
- `TransportController::states` (`transport.update.state`, bulk): same check before anything is read; a garage posting a selection is refused as a whole. The dealer scope in the query is gone with it, since only an administrator reaches it.
- Both ask one private guard, `planningIsOurs()`.
- The transport window (`_modal/show_footer.blade.php`): no planning-step button and no step script for a garage user; it reads the progress in the title and the badge as before. The administrator's window is unchanged. Nothing is restyled.

Paying, confirming a price, cancelling before payment and requesting are untouched and stay the garage's.

## Business rules

R S4-10.11 is reworded (kind `rechten`): only a platform administrator sets the three steps, a garage is refused with 403 and reads the progress. The sentence that called the open routes an open question is gone, because it is answered. No rule lapsed and nothing is renumbered.

## Tests (`TransportChainTest`, all tagged `@rule S4-10.11`)

- a garage is refused (403) on the single step and on the bulk step from each of `paid`, `transport_requested` and `pickup_confirmed`, with the state unchanged; also on another garage's transport;
- a garage's bulk selection is refused as a whole, then the administrator moves the same selection (own and other garage's rows, never an unpaid one), `completed` stays final;
- the administrator still gets exactly the next step in the window and the route refuses any other (422);
- the window of a garage shows the state and no step control, script or step URL;
- cancelling before payment still works for the garage.

The two existing tests that walked the steps as the requesting dealer are rewritten to the new rule.

`phpstan-baseline.neon`: one count for `TransportController` goes from 4 to 3, because the dealer scope in `states()` was removed.

Full suite locally: 2652 tests, 21158 assertions, green (1 skipped and 1 incomplete, as on main). PHPStan: no errors.
params.title: Planning steps of a paid transport are ours: a garage gets 403 and reads the progress
